name: Obscura Incarnate
source:
This is the story of how Olya, a depressed pathologist, meets a little girl with a strange personality in the middle of a winter forest. Together they figure out how to live life in general.

[Translated from [url=https://yuurenkyouko.itch.io/obscura-incarnate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是关于奥莉亚（Olya），一位抑郁的病理学家，如何在冬季森林中遇到一个性格奇怪的小女孩的故事。他们一起思考如何度过一般的生活。

[译自[url=https://yuurenkyouko.itch.io/obscura-incarnate]itch.io[/url]]
